intent.problem: Software expectations are scattered across specifications, docs and custom rules.

safety.reason: Source-only review and bounded declarative checks. Execute external suites on an independently controlled runner.

product.benefit: Find documented behavior a change breaks and see how to check it.
product.how_it_works: Captures the source, requests rule approval, plans eligible specialist checks and reconciles their observations in one report.
product.input: A local source folder or a prepared Git comparison. Optional Markdown rules and mapped JUnit evidence.
product.output: A consolidated verification verdict with four specialist tabs, source citations and a complete attempt inventory.
product.customizable_for: Software expectations and prohibitions supplied as Markdown.
